notes.title: Demo Hotfix: Small Issues Resolved #2
notes.notes:
Hotfix Changelog:

Improved object placement from hand into target positions (e.g., computer)

Items taken off furniture are now marked as packed and ready for transport

Removed physics-based furniture lifting in Hard mode (caused flickering and physics glitches)

Holding the pickup key now collects multiple items automatically

Automatically selects the right box or bag when clicking on an item to pack

Text and localization improvements

Radial menu can now also be opened with the Tab key

Minor tutorial adjustments

notes.title: Demo Hotfix: Small Issues Resolved
notes.notes:
Hotfix Changelog: 

Tailgate indicator fixed 

Prevented items from falling under the wardrobe

Prevented items from falling under the floor

Completed missing shop item descriptions

Resolved control lock issue caused by player overlapping with furniture upon drop

Fixed an issue where mission progress could stall in certain cases

Placed objects could still be marked as placement targets – fixed 

Fixed an issue where a wardrobe not marked for moving could be picked up

Picking up that wardrobe could launch the player into space
